item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
from pathlib import Path
import re, html
p=Path('/home/user/Desktop/HK_train_record.docx')
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    xml=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
# Convert paragraph breaks and text nodes into plain-ish text.
xml=xml.replace('</w:p>', '\\n')
texts=re.findall(r'<w:t["'^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>'"', xml)
# Need preserve paragraph boundaries better: replace text tags in order with newlines already inserted.
plain=re.sub(r'<w:t["'^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>'"', lambda m: html.unescape(m.group(1)), xml)
plain=re.sub(r'<["'^>]+>'"', '', plain)
lines=[line.strip() for line in plain.splitlines() if line.strip()]
records=[]
for line in lines:
    # expected: HH:MM:SS,TRAIN,STATION,PLATFORM ; tolerate spaces after commas
    m=re.match(r'"'^('"\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2})\\s*,\\s*(["'^,'"\\s]+)\\s*,\\s*(["'^,'"\\s]+)\\s*,\\s*(\\S+)\\s*"'$'"', line)
    if m:
        records.append(m.groups())
    else:
        print('UNPARSED:', repr(line))
unique=[]
seen=set()
for _, train, _, _ in records:
    if train not in seen:
        seen.add(train)
        unique.append(train)
print('records', len(records))
print('unique_train_ids', len(unique))
print('unique list:', ', '.join(unique))
# Write useful files on Desktop.
out=Path('/home/user/Desktop/HK_train_unique_train_ids.txt')
out.write_text('\\n'.join(unique)+'\\n')
# Also write deduped first occurrence full record by train id.
out2=Path('/home/user/Desktop/HK_train_deduplicated_first_records.csv')
first=[]; seen=set()
for rec in records:
    if rec[1] not in seen:
        seen.add(rec[1]); first.append(rec)
out2.write_text('time,train_id,station_id,platform_no\\n'+'\\n'.join(','.join(r) for r in first)+'\\n')
print('wrote', out)
print('wrote', out2)
PY"
